attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The proof is conditional on a row-separable row-normal parser. Arbitrary full EF+SAT_U can use real formula semantics, and arbitrary occurrence-local EF may contain short cross-row parity constraints unless the calculus forbids or charges them.
steps: Fix N, epsilon, q, rho with max{q,rho}<1+epsilon and define H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)).
Parse an accepted row-normal transcript pi into Q_pi; define ForcedRows(Q_pi) as rows whose parity is fixed over all assignments satisfying Q_pi.
Use parser invariance: acceptance of pi depends only on Q_pi, so any private label assignment A satisfying Q_pi preserves the accepted transcript.
If Q_pi is row-separable, choose A_Q so every unforced row has parity 0 and every forced row has its Q_pi-forced parity.
Build a circuit for H_{A_Q}: output 0 by default and patch the forced rows with equality tests; size is O(C(Q_pi))+O(|ForcedRows|N)+N^{o(1)}.
Functional certificate soundness says the same accepted pi certifies C(H_{A_Q})>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}. If |ForcedRows|<N^{epsilon-o(1)} and C(Q_pi)=N^{o(1)}, this contradicts the patch circuit.
Therefore any sound row-normal functional occurrence-local certificate must force N^{epsilon-o(1)} complete rows, or leave the method class.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This proves a restricted certificate no-go, not a lower bound for H_N^SAT and not P != NP. Promotion beyond EF+SAT_U^{occ,row} needs a valid semantic-to-occurrence extraction theorem or an explicit restriction in the paper statement.

assumptions: Circuit model is nonuniform Boolean SIZE with fan-in two gates; equality patching for one N-bit source row costs O(N).
The proof system is the restricted occurrence-local EF+SAT_U^{occ,row} model: SAT facts are represented only by private occurrence labels and row-normal rules, not by real formula semantics.
Functional soundness is parametric: if pi accepts Q_pi, the certified lower-bound conclusion applies to every occurrence-label assignment satisfying Q_pi.
No hidden advice may encode the true SAT label vector or a row selector outside the parsed transcript; otherwise ForcedRows is not a valid observable.
The beta-zero transfer is kept separate from the certificate no-go: SAT circuits substitute into labels only through polylog-length generated instances.
This is a route-level obstruction theorem for a certificate family; it does not establish a lower bound for H_N^SAT itself.
definitions: source object: a row-normal EF+SAT_U^{occ} proof transcript pi over occurrence labels y_{x,j} attached to generated formulas G_N(x,j) in the beta-zero XOR carrier H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)).
target object: a scoped route-specific no-go theorem for proof-mediated barely-superlinear source lower-bound certificates, not a proof of P != NP or NP not subset P/poly.

controlled interface: the parser pi -> Q_pi exposes touched occurrence labels, row-local constraints, the set ForcedRows(Q_pi), and the functional conclusion C(H_A)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} over all label assignments A satisfying Q_pi.

target-preserving condition: M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, L_N=(log N)^d, generator size N^{rho+o(1)}, beta=0, max{q,rho}<1+epsilon, and the certificate is advice-free, functional over occurrence labels, and row-separable after parsing.
Complete row: a source input x is complete-forced if the row parity xor_{j<=M_N} y_{x,j} is constant over all occurrence-label assignments satisfying Q_pi.
ForcedRows(Q_pi): the set of complete-forced source rows; it is syntactically inspectable from Q_pi and does not refer to the desired lower bound.
Row-separable Q_pi: after fixing global syntactic parameters, constraints on occurrence labels factor over rows, so every unforced row has two extensions with opposite parity while preserving Q_pi.

equations.label: beta_zero_transfer
equations.latex: SAT in SIZE(n^c) => C(H_N^SAT) <= N^{rho+o(1)} + M_N L_N^c = N^{max{rho,q}+o(1)}
equations.valid_when: Valid when generated formulas have length L_N=(log N)^d, M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, beta=0, and one SAT circuit of size L_N^c is reused uniformly across all generated instances.

equations.label: private_spoof_upper_bound
equations.valid_when: Valid when Q_pi is row-separable, unforced row parities can be set to zero independently, and forced rows are patched by N-bit equality tests.

equations.label: forced_row_threshold
equations.latex: C(H_{A_Q}) > N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} and C(Q_pi)=N^{o(1)} imply |ForcedRows(Q_pi)| >= N^{epsilon-o(1)}
equations.valid_when: Applies after functional certificate soundness transfers the same lower-bound conclusion to every private occurrence-label assignment satisfying the parsed row-normal constraints.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: A falsifier to the lemma is a row-normal accepted transcript whose Q_pi couples many row parities by a short cross-row constraint while keeping ForcedRows small; such a rule violates the row-separable parser assumption and must be either forbidden or charged.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Main proof-delivery packet: converts the row-residual audit into a conditional theorem for row-normal occurrence-local certificates and isolates the exact parser gap.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Conditional row-normal occurrence no-go: Fix epsilon>0 and the beta-zero XOR carrier H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)) with M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, L_N=(log N)^d, and generator size N^{rho+o(1)}. Let pi be an accepted row-normal functional EF+SAT_U^{occ} certificate whose conclusion is C(H)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} for every occurrence-label assignment satisfying its parsed constraints Q_pi. If Q_pi is row-separable and |ForcedRows(Q_pi)|<N^{epsilon-o(1)}, then pi is not sound: there is a private occurrence-label assignment A_Q satisfying Q_pi for which the induced parity carrier has circuits of size N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}. Hence any valid certificate in this method class must force at least N^{epsilon-o(1)} complete parity rows, unless it exits by nonfunctionality, nonconstructivity, nonlargeness, or real SAT-semantic nonrelativization.

assumptions: The verifier is deterministic or its randomness is fixed inside the transcript; no adaptive unparsed SAT query remains.
All extension variables introduced by EF lines are syntactic abbreviations whose defining equations are included in Q_pi.
Occurrence-local SAT_U axioms mention only the private label variables and declared row-normal relations.
definitions: source object: a finite proof transcript pi consisting of EF derivation lines plus occurrence-label atoms y_{x,j}.
target object: transcript acceptance under private label assignments A that need not be realizable as real SAT truth labels.
controlled interface: Q_pi is the set of occurrence atoms, row parity atoms, and syntactic side conditions actually read by the verifier.
target-preserving condition: every rule of EF+SAT_U^{occ,row} is local in Q_pi and has no semantic oracle access to real satisfiability beyond the named occurrence labels.

equations.label: invariance_schema
equations.latex: A |= Q_pi and A' |= Q_pi => Accept(pi,A)=Accept(pi,A')
equations.valid_when: Valid when every verification predicate is a Boolean consequence of the parsed constraints Q_pi and no rule inspects real formula syntax semantically.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: A counterexample is a rule whose acceptance depends on real SAT semantics of G_N(x,j) while still being counted as occurrence-local; that rule moves the argument to the full EF+SAT_U extraction boundary.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Supports the main theorem by justifying the private occurrence-label spoof rather than merely asserting a relativizing oracle intuition.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Parser-invariance lemma: In EF+SAT_U^{occ,row}, the accepted status of pi is determined only by Q_pi and is invariant under every private occurrence-label assignment A satisfying Q_pi. Therefore the private spoof A_Q that zeroes all unforced row parities preserves the transcript.

assumptions: Real SAT-semantic rules are not invariant under independent occurrence-label flips.
Any claimed full-system theorem must specify whether it is nonrelativizing and how it defeats the private-row falsifier.
The extraction statement may be false; the restricted EF+SAT_U^{occ,row} theorem remains valid independently.
definitions: source object: full EF+SAT_U proofs allowed to reason about real generated SAT formulas, extension variables, and local soundness clauses.
target object: an extraction theorem producing Q_pi and ForcedRows(Q_pi) from full proofs without target-equivalent lower-bound content.
controlled interface: semantic proof lines must be replaced by occurrence constraints or charged as forced complete rows.
target-preserving condition: extraction overhead must be N^{o(1)} or otherwise below the N^{1+epsilon} source threshold, and must not leak the SAT label vector as nonuniform advice.

equations.label: extraction_threshold
equations.valid_when: Required when a full EF+SAT_U proof is converted to an occurrence-local certificate while preserving the subthreshold spoof-and-patch contradiction.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If extraction needs the actual lower bound for H_N or encodes the SAT truth vector as advice, then it is target-equivalent and invalid for this route.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Boundary and demotion lemma: separates the proved restricted no-go from the open full EF+SAT_U ambition.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Full EF+SAT_U boundary lemma: The row-normal occurrence no-go does not automatically cover full EF+SAT_U. If a proof line can use the actual CNF syntax of G_N(x,j) to derive constraints invariant under true SAT but not under private label flips, then parser invariance fails. Promotion to full EF+SAT_U requires a nonrelativizing semantic-to-occurrence extraction theorem that turns such reasoning into syntactic complete-row forcing with subthreshold overhead.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot only if a row-normal occurrence rule with uncharged cross-row parity constraints falsifies row-separability or if functional soundness cannot be stated without real SAT labels.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote to proof queue only after either proving row-normalization for the intended EF+SAT_U^{occ} rules or explicitly restricting the paper theorem to EF+SAT_U^{occ,row} with prior-art boundary and inference-quality review.
control_decision.reason: A contribution-making restricted no-go theorem is now theorem-shaped, with equations, parser invariance, and a named blocking gap for full EF+SAT_U; broad exploration would be lower priority.

dependency_updates.description: The substitution bound for H_N^SAT remains C(H)<=N^{max{rho,q}+o(1)} under SAT in SIZE(n^c), since L_N is polylogarithmic and beta=0.
Parser theorem is now usable for EF+SAT_U^{occ,row} with row-separability; arbitrary cross-row occurrence constraints require a charge or a countermodel.
Invariance is proved for rules whose verification predicate is a Boolean consequence of Q_pi, and fails exactly at real SAT-semantic access.
Full EF+SAT_U promotion still needs nonrelativizing extraction from real formula reasoning to syntactic ForcedRows without advice leakage.

falsifiers: Row-separability falsifier: a short accepted occurrence rule imposes a global cross-row parity equation that zeroes many spoof choices while ForcedRows remains small.
Functional-soundness falsifier: the certificate conclusion applies only to real SAT labels, so private occurrence-label spoofing no longer gives a contradiction.
Sparse-row residual falsifier: a circuit D_N agrees with H_N^SAT off E<N^{epsilon-o(1)} source rows, giving C(H_N^SAT)<=C(D_N)+O(EN) below the claimed threshold.
Nonuniform-advice falsifier: Q_pi or the verifier hides a selected set of hard rows or the SAT label vector, invalidating the advice-free parser.
Positive-beta falsifier: if the carrier secretly uses target queries of length N^beta with beta>0, the substitution window becomes q+beta c and cannot exclude all SAT exponents.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: For eta<epsilon the spoof assignment makes the induced parity function zero off N^eta rows and hence has size N^{1+eta+o(1)}, contradicting any valid N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} functional certificate. At eta>=epsilon the sparse-patch contradiction no longer fires.
held_fixed_controls: beta=0 polylog target-query length and generator overhead N^{rho+o(1)}.
Functional occurrence-label soundness: accepted pi must certify the same lower-bound statement for every A satisfying Q_pi.
No hidden advice and no real SAT-semantic rule outside EF+SAT_U^{occ,row}.
Equality patching cost O(N) per exceptional source row.
gedanken_experiment_design.need_decision: Use now as a falsifier probe for the row-normal parser and transcript-invariance lemmas.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The current proof item needs a concrete check that private row spoofing is not just a restatement of relativization folklore; it must expose exactly which occurrence-local rules preserve or break the contradiction.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: Take H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=N^q} SAT(G_N(x,j)) with L_N=(log N)^d, q,rho<1+epsilon. Give the verifier a transcript pi whose Q_pi touches all labels in N^eta complete rows and only one label in every other row.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A formal parser-invariance certificate showing that every accepted transcript in the named proof system factors through Q_pi and that unforced row parities have independent extensions.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: eta=log_N |ForcedRows(Q_pi)|, varied from 0 to epsilon while q,rho,d and verifier size stay fixed.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 83 upgrades the proof-delivery packet from a parser slogan to a conditional theorem: row-separable row-normal functional occurrence certificates must force N^{epsilon-o(1)} complete XOR rows, or private occurrence-label spoofing yields a valid subthreshold circuit for the induced carrier. The remaining open obligation is no longer ordinary soundness but the exact row-normalization/extraction step for broader EF+SAT_U.

negative_tactic_decision.conflict_target: A claimed barely-superlinear lower-bound certificate for the beta-zero XOR source carrier that does not syntactically force enough complete rows.
negative_tactic_decision.contradiction_carrier_or_no_go_family: Private occurrence-label spoof A_Q sets all unforced row parities to zero; equality patching on forced rows gives C(H_{A_Q})<=O(C(Q_pi))+O(|ForcedRows|N)+N^{o(1)}.
escape_conditions: Force at least N^{epsilon-o(1)} complete parity rows in the parsed transcript.
Use a nonfunctional or nonlarge certificate whose soundness is not parametric over occurrence-label assignments.
Use real SAT semantics in a nonrelativizing way and prove a semantic-to-occurrence extraction theorem.
Provide a direct lower bound for H_N^SAT rather than a proof-mediated occurrence certificate.
Leave beta=0 intact; if beta>0 appears, the separate substitution-cap falsifier q+beta c applies.
negative_tactic_decision.exact_negation_or_method_class: Row-normal functional occurrence-local EF+SAT_U^{occ,row} certificates with |ForcedRows(Q_pi)|<N^{epsilon-o(1)} and no real SAT-semantic access.
negative_tactic_decision.next_validation_handoff: Send to pvsnp-forcedrows-proof-workflow for rule-level parser verification, then to proof-gap-countermodel-splitter to search for uncharged cross-row occurrence constraints, then to pvsnp-inference-quality-controller before promotion.
negative_tactic_decision.paper_contribution_potential: High as a scoped paper theorem if restricted to EF+SAT_U^{occ,row} or if row-normalization is proved; otherwise it is still a precise no-go boundary and falsifier for functional occurrence-certificate routes.
proof_obligations: Formalize the exact EF+SAT_U^{occ,row} rule set and prove every verifier predicate factors through Q_pi.
Prove row-separable extension for unforced rows or charge every cross-row parity constraint as forced-row information.
Check C(Q_pi)=N^{o(1)} or include its cost in the spoof upper bound.
Run the prior-art boundary against natural proofs, relativization/oracles, proof-complexity feasible interpolation, MCSP/MKtP carriers, and known hardness-magnification audits.
Record that the result is a scoped no-go for certificate methods, not a proof of P != NP.
negative_tactic_decision.reason_for_tactic: The decisive issue is not a generic barrier but whether a proof-mediated source lower-bound certificate survives private occurrence-label spoofing and sparse-row patching below the N^{1+epsilon} threshold.

branch_outputs.next_experiment: Instantiate the EF+SAT_U^{occ,row} rule ledger: for each extension, weakening, substitution, SAT_U occurrence axiom, and derived parity line, mark whether it is Q_pi-local, row-separable, or a charged cross-row constraint; the first uncharged cross-row rule becomes the countermodel or repair target.

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: No proof yet that every standard full EF+SAT_U transcript admitting a beta-zero XOR certificate has a row-syntax realizer with small Q, nor that every failure of realizability yields a large syntactic hitting number.
steps: Start from the proved EF+SAT_U^{occ} packet: parser pi -> Q_pi and private occurrence-label perturbations preserve accepted transcripts outside ForcedRows(Q_pi).
Attempt the same perturbation in full EF+SAT_U by changing only one off-Q row of H_N^{SAT}.

Observe the new obstruction: formula-DAG equality fibers E_pi may connect occurrences in different rows, so a one-row perturbation can violate equality or SAT_U consistency even when no queried local proof rule mentions the lower bound.

Define row-syntax realizer A_Q as the missing transfer certificate: it must assign formula syntax and SAT_U values consistently on every equality fiber while realizing the spoof truth table outside Q.
With A_Q, transcript preservation plus soundness says the spoofed easy object cannot be accepted; sparse patching gives C(H_N^{SAT})<=S_D+O(|Q|N), forcing |Q|>=Omega((N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}-S_D)/N).
Without A_Q, shared-DAG equality over two unforced rows is a finite falsifier to lifting occurrence-local private-label invariance into full EF+SAT_U.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: The result is a valid conditional lift-or-block theorem and a sharper boundary lemma, but not a full EF+SAT_U no-go. The missing theorem is row-syntax-realizability or a universal equality-fiber charge lower bound for real formula encodings.

assumptions: Model: full EF+SAT_U allows extension variables and a SAT_U predicate over explicit formula syntax; unlike EF+SAT_U^{occ}, repeated formula DAG nodes must remain syntactically equal.
Uniformity: G_N, the parser, and the patch construction are computable in poly(N); pi may be nonuniform only as the certificate being audited.
Soundness regime: accepted transcripts assert a semantic lower bound C(H_N^{SAT})>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} against the named Boolean circuit model.
Quantitative regime: the spoof baseline size S_D is below N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}; the clean threshold |Q_pi|>=N^{epsilon-o(1)} uses S_D=N^{1+o(1)}.

Barrier regime: if projection width and decision width are O(log N) and DirectClusterSound holds, the accepted shadow is a valid natural property, so this lemma is a no-go/escape audit rather than main-conjecture progress.
definitions: source object: full EF+SAT_U proof transcript pi for H_N^{SAT}(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)), with formula syntax shared across queried occurrences.
target object: a scoped lift-or-block theorem for proof-mediated beta-zero XOR lower-bound certificates, not a proof of P != NP.
controlled interface: parser pi -> (Q_pi, E_pi, Occ_pi, row(.), ForcedRows(Q_pi)) plus a row-syntax realizer A_{Q_pi} satisfying transcript preservation.

target-preserving condition: A_{Q_pi} is produced without using the desired circuit lower bound, preserves uniform G_N lengths and full EF+SAT_U equality atoms, and yields a small spoof/patch circuit in the same nonuniform target model.

row-syntax realizer: an assignment of formula strings and SAT_U truth values to off-Q_pi occurrences that is constant on every equality fiber of E_pi and agrees with the spoof truth table outside Q_pi.
complete row: all SAT-query occurrences G_N(x,j), j<=M_N, contributing to the XOR value H_N^{SAT}(x).

equations.label: beta_zero_xor_carrier
equations.valid_when: Valid when H_N is the beta-zero XOR carrier with uniform G_N, bounded query count M_N, and logarithmic SAT-query length.

equations.label: sparse_patch_bound
equations.valid_when: Applies after the full EF+SAT_U transcript is preserved by a row-syntax realizer and D_N agrees with H_N outside Q_pi.

equations.label: row_charge_threshold
equations.valid_when: Requires the claimed source lower bound, a below-threshold spoof circuit, and the sparse patch inequality in the same circuit model.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Construct pi with two unforced rows sharing one formula-DAG node queried by SAT_U. Perturbing one row changes the node value while equality requires both copies to match; transcript invariance fails unless the equality fiber is charged to Q_pi or a realizer supplies a common formula.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: This is the cycle-83 proof-delivery packet: it makes the full EF+SAT_U gap a named conditional theorem plus a precise falsifier, instead of repeating the occurrence-local result.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Full EF+SAT_U lift-or-block gate: for beta-zero XOR certificates claiming C(H_N^{SAT})>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}, the occurrence-local ForcedRows theorem lifts to full EF+SAT_U exactly under a row-syntax realizer preserving all queried formula-equality and SAT_U atoms outside Q_pi. Under that condition any sound accepted transcript has |Q_pi|>=N^{epsilon-o(1)} when the spoof circuit has size N^{1+o(1)}. Without this realizer, shared formula-DAG equality is a finite falsifier to automatic private-label invariance.

assumptions: Only formula-syntax equality and occurrence row labels are used; no lower-bound oracle or semantic circuit-hardness predicate is consulted.
The perturbation class includes two off-Q rows receiving different private labels, so equality fibers crossing both rows obstruct invariance.
The theorem is restricted to full EF+SAT_U syntax; it is vacuous in EF+SAT_U^{occ}, where occurrences are private by definition.
definitions: source object: equality graph E_pi on SAT_U formula occurrences in a full EF+SAT_U transcript.
target object: syntactic charge lower bound on rows needed for private perturbation invariance.
controlled interface: row map from occurrences to beta-zero XOR rows and equality-fiber hitting set Q.
observable: tau_syn(pi), the minimum number of rows that must be removed so every remaining equality fiber lies in at most one row.

equations.label: syntactic_hitting_number
equations.valid_when: Valid when E_pi is the equality relation forced by shared formula syntax in the parsed full EF+SAT_U transcript.

equations.label: invariance_implies_charge
equations.valid_when: Applies when the claimed invariance must survive arbitrary independent private perturbations on every uncharged row.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If the intended proof only needs one globally consistent spoof rather than arbitrary private perturbations, tau_syn may overcharge; then L1's weaker row-syntax realizer, not L2, is the correct obligation.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: This supplies a finite, inspectable obstruction for the full-transfer boundary lemma.
candidate_lemmas.statement: If full EF+SAT_U private-row invariance is required for arbitrary off-Q_pi perturbations, then Q_pi must hit every cross-row equality fiber of the transcript. Thus either the syntactic hitting number tau_syn(pi) is already N^{epsilon-o(1)}, giving row forcing without SAT semantics, or automatic lifting from EF+SAT_U^{occ} is invalid.

assumptions: The verifier and projection enumerator run in poly(N), with b+w=O(log N) for naturalization.
Usefulness is universal over all circuits of the named size bound, not merely over the actual SAT truth table.
The sparse residual branch assumes a spoof D_N of size S_D below the claimed lower-bound threshold and transcript preservation outside Q.
definitions: source object: accepted low-projection certificate cluster C for the beta-zero XOR truth table.
target object: either a valid natural property against the named circuit class or a sparse-residual no-go for the certificate route.
controlled interface: projection width b, decision width w, DirectClusterSound(C,k), and row-syntax realizer A_Q.
observable: density of the existential accepted shadow and residual row set size |Q|.

equations.label: accepted_shadow_density
equations.valid_when: Valid when an accepted transcript has a fixed accepting view whose queried truth-table and proof-projection bits total b+w.

equations.label: naturalization_threshold
equations.valid_when: Applies when the view bits are explicitly enumerable and the accepting predicate is decidable in polynomial time.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Odd-charge Tseitin clusters satisfy strong local consistency while the existential local shadow has density one and no usefulness, so DirectClusterSound cannot be replaced by ordinary soundness.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: This ties the full EF+SAT_U realizer gate back to the natural-proofs audit and prevents ordinary soundness from being mistaken for a valid bridge.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For low-projection proof-mediated beta-zero XOR certificates, a row-syntax realizer creates a fork: DirectClusterSound plus O(log N) projection width naturalizes the accepted shadow, while failure of DirectClusterSound leaves the sparse-row residual falsifier as the only valid obstruction. Ordinary local consistency does not bridge the fork.

control_decision.pivot_test: Backtrack or quarantine full EF+SAT_U claims if a two-row shared-DAG transcript defeats both row-syntax realization and syntactic row charging.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote to theorem-section status only after proving for standard EF+SAT_U encodings that every accepted transcript has A_Q with controlled Q or tau_syn(pi)>=N^{epsilon-o(1)}, followed by inference-quality review.
control_decision.reason: The branch improved the proof-delivery queue by naming the exact full EF+SAT_U obstruction and a conditional row-forcing theorem, but the universal row-syntax-realizability lemma is still unproved.

dependency_updates.description: The full-transfer gap is now row-syntax-realizability for shared formula-DAG equality fibers, not generic formula-syntax extraction.
The EF+SAT_U^{occ} ForcedRows theorem remains valid; full EF+SAT_U inherits it only with row-syntax realizer A_Q or a syntactic equality-fiber charge theorem.
Low-projection DirectClusterSound branches still naturalize; the realizer gate does not by itself escape largeness, constructivity, and usefulness tension.
The obstruction uses unrelativized proof syntax and formula equality, so it is outside a purely relativizing argument but has not established a nonalgebrizing main-conjecture route.

falsifiers: Shared-DAG equality falsifier: two off-Q rows share one SAT_U formula node, so private perturbation of one row breaks full EF+SAT_U syntax although it was allowed in EF+SAT_U^{occ}.
Odd-charge Tseitin falsifier: bounded local consistency can accept every projected view while no global satisfying assignment exists, so ordinary soundness is not DirectClusterSound.
Sparse residual falsifier: if a spoof D_N agrees with H_N^{SAT} outside Q and |Q|<N^{epsilon-o(1)}, the patch circuit contradicts a claimed N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} source lower bound.
Natural-shadow falsifier: if a low-width cluster also has DirectClusterSound, it yields a large constructive useful property and faces PRF/natural-proofs pressure rather than escaping barriers.
Advice-leakage falsifier: if Q_pi is selected by hidden nonuniform advice not recoverable from pi, the patch and density calculations are not valid target-preserving transfers.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: If gamma is large, equality fibers may themselves force many rows and produce a syntactic row-charge lower bound. If gamma is small but cross-row fibers remain uncharged, private occurrence perturbation is invalid and a separate row-syntax realizer is necessary.
held_fixed_controls: H_N^{SAT} remains the beta-zero XOR carrier with M_N<=N^{q+o(1)} and L_N=(log N)^d.
The claimed source threshold remains C(H_N^{SAT})>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} in the same nonuniform Boolean circuit model.
Projection and decision width remain O(log N) so any DirectClusterSound branch would be a valid natural-property object.
No hidden advice is allowed in selecting Q_pi or constructing the spoof D_N.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The branch is blocked at full EF+SAT_U row-syntax extraction; a concrete shared-syntax experiment tests whether the obstruction is a rare encoding artifact or the central transfer barrier.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: Build a padded SAT-query family G_N(x,j) in which many rows reuse a common formula template T_z through shared DAG nodes, then compare an EF+SAT_U^{occ} transcript with a full EF+SAT_U transcript enforcing equality of the shared nodes.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A formal row-syntax-realizability theorem or an equality-fiber hitting theorem: for every accepted full EF+SAT_U transcript, either produce A_Q with |Q| below the sparse-patch threshold or prove tau_syn(pi)>=N^{epsilon-o(1)}.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: gamma, the maximum number of distinct beta-zero XOR rows touched by one equality fiber of the full EF+SAT_U formula-DAG syntax.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 83 converts the full EF+SAT_U boundary into a precise combinatorial gate: shared formula-DAG equality creates equality fibers, and a full lift needs either a row-syntax realizer for the sparse spoof or a large equality-fiber row charge. This is valid route-level proof-boundary progress; it strengthens the occurrence-local no-go packet but is not evidence for P != NP.

negative_tactic_decision.conflict_target: SIZE(m^k)-secure pseudorandom functions or any cryptographic hardness assumption for the exact circuit class separated by the induced property
negative_tactic_decision.contradiction_carrier_or_no_go_family: natural-proofs tuple plus the route-specific sparse-row residual and shared-DAG equality falsifier families
escape_conditions: Non-large certificate shadow, e.g. projection or decision width superlogarithmic in N.
Nonconstructive semantic certificate whose membership is not decidable in poly(N) and whose nonconstructivity is still target-preserving.

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The derivation is complete only for equality-free occurrence-local transcripts. Full EF+SAT_U can use formula-identity or extension-variable equality to tie private occurrence labels together; promotion needs an equality-graph parser proving that such ties either raise alpha_ad, create forced complete rows, or are outside the scoped theorem.
steps: Fix N, M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, generator overhead rho, transcript pi, residual set R_N, and adaptive-cover exponent alpha_ad.
Run Scan(pi) to form Q_pi and LocSat(Q_pi); this is syntactic and does not query H_N^SAT.
Define ForcedRows(Q_pi) by constancy of row parity over LocSat(Q_pi), with untouched occurrence labels free.
For any nonforced row x, choose A,A' in LocSat(Q_pi) with different row parity; equality-free occurrence locality ensures pi accepts both because all checked constraints are in Q_pi.
Therefore a valid row-parity-binding certificate cannot claim x unless x is in ForcedRows(Q_pi) or x is declared residual.
Use the adaptive cover to build D_N: on unforced nonresidual rows, compute the certificate's predicted labels for all j<=M_N and XOR them; the size is N^{max{rho,q+alpha_ad}+o(1)}.
Patch all forced and residual rows by equality-to-x indicators and hardwired correct output bits; this costs O((|ForcedRows|+|R_N|)N).
Conclude C(H_N^SAT)<=N^{max{rho,q+alpha_ad,max(f,r)+1}+o(1)}.

If a source claim asserts C(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} and rho,q+alpha_ad<1+epsilon while f,r<epsilon, the certificate route is refuted; otherwise the theorem only records the needed forced-row mass or overhead escape.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a restricted-model route falsifier, not a proof of P != NP. It also assumes the low-cover predictor D_N is extractable from the named certificate family and still needs prior-art boundary review before paper promotion.

assumptions: Model: unrestricted Boolean circuit size is the lower-bound target; the proof system restriction is occurrence-local and equality-free, so no rule identifies two generated SAT formulas by global syntax.
Uniformity: G_N and the parser for pi are uniform in N; hardwiring pi is allowed only for a route-level negative upper bound against that fixed certificate family.
Cover regime: the label predictor induced by pi has adaptive-cover exponent alpha_ad=max{tau,max_l(a_l+mu_l),max_l omega_l}.
Query regime: M_N<=N^{q+o(1)} and every queried formula has length polylog(N), so SAT-label evaluation cost is charged through the cover, not through an oracle.
Soundness regime: valid row-parity binding means every accepted local transcript certifying a row must have the same row parity on all assignments in LocSat(Q_pi).
Residual regime: |R_N|<=N^{r+o(1)} and |ForcedRows(Q_pi)|<=N^{f+o(1)} when the upper-bound alternative is invoked.
Threshold regime: the intended contradiction is only to a claimed source lower bound C(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} with rho<1+epsilon, q+alpha_ad<1+epsilon, r<epsilon, and f<epsilon.
definitions: source object: an accepted EF+SAT_U^{occ,eqfree} transcript pi for H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)), where M_N<=N^{q+o(1)} and G_N has circuit overhead N^{rho+o(1)}.
target object: a scoped no-go theorem for proof-mediated beta-zero XOR certificates, not a proof of P != NP.
controlled interface: the parser pi -> Q_pi, the local SAT-label space LocSat(Q_pi), the syntactic set ForcedRows(Q_pi), an adaptive-cover circuit for labels, and a sparse patch for exceptional rows.

target-preserving condition: the circuit upper bound computes the same truth table H_N^SAT at length N by advice-free uniform construction of G_N and by hardwiring only the fixed transcript pi, never a nonuniform hard-row selector.

complete row: an input x is complete for pi if all M_N occurrence labels SAT(G_N(x,j)) relevant to the beta-zero row parity have names in the occurrence universe of Q_pi or are default-free variables in LocSat(Q_pi).
LocSat(Q_pi): the set of assignments to occurrence labels satisfying every formula-internal SAT-consistency constraint and every equality-free local constraint explicitly touched by pi.
ForcedRows(Q_pi): rows x for which xor_{j<=M_N} y_{x,j} is constant over LocSat(Q_pi), with untouched labels treated as free private occurrence variables.
residual rows: an externally declared set R_N on which the low-cover certificate is allowed not to match H_N^SAT and which must be patched explicitly.
